form:FormGroup.label: Kind
form:FormGroup.helpText: pattern matches a tree at the cursor; take consumes a length; seek moves the cursor by a length, or to an offset; read casts the bytes at the cursor.

form:FormGroup.label: Pattern tree
form:FormGroup.helpText: The pattern node in its wire form, as the tree tab holds it.

form:FormGroup.label: Length
form:FormGroup.helpText: A count of bytes, or the value a label or a variable holds.

form:FormGroup.label: Absolute
form:FormGroup.helpText: Seek to this offset from the start of the match, rather than by this many bytes.

form:FormGroup.label: As
form:FormGroup.helpText: What the bytes at the cursor mean; the read consumes the cast's width.

form:FormGroup.label: Label
form:FormGroup.helpText: Names what this part took or read, for a capture to bind. Blank for none.
